issues.extracted: property tax 8,940,030 = Taxes 11,086,765 - Sales Tax fund 2,146,735
issues.on_page: p4 Taxes: General 2,502,807 + Bond 379,812 + Sales Tax 2,146,735 + TIF 6,057,411 = 11,086,765; p2 SoA taxes: Property 8,967,603, Sales 2,146,735 (Intergovernmental 554,803 = fund Intergovernmental line)
issues.issue: Classification supported under the relaxed subtraction rule. The subtraction is exact, sales tax is proven entirely in the Sales Tax fund (fund column = SoA Sales), and the SoA's only other tax type is Property, so the statements establish the remainder as property. The remainder is 27,573 below SoA Property. The trimmed pages support this being a property-tax accrual: the only deferred inflow is 'Unavailable revenue - taxes receivable' 46,441, held in the General and Bond funds, and the Sales Tax fund has none. The cited reconciliation (full PDF p19), though, is not in the trimmed PDF, so the exact 27,573 attribution could not be confirmed here.
